Complaint: won't drain — points toward Drain Pump.
Complaint: no fill — points toward Fill / Water Supply.
Complaint: won't spin — points toward Drive Motor.
Complaint: won't agitate — points toward Drive Motor.
Complaint: lid lock issue — points toward Door / Lid Lock.
Won't drain complaint with failed drain operation — drain pump path.
Won't drain with drain pump open at meter — pump failure confirmed.
No fill complaint with failed fill operation — inlet valve or supply path.
No fill with inlet valve coil open — valve failure confirmed.
Won't spin with failed spin operation — drive motor or transmission path.
Won't spin with drive motor open — motor failure confirmed.
Won't agitate with failed agitation — drive motor or mode shifter path.
Door/lid lock complaint with failed lock operation — latch or switch path.
Lock issue with door lock switch open — lock assembly failure.
Failed drain operation with pump open — replace drain pump.
Leak complaint with bad hoses/connections — fill path leak source.
Walking/vibration with poor balance on spin — suspension or load issue; check drive if mechanical OK.
Won't drain with weak drain pump amps — pump struggling or blocked.
Leak with damaged door boot — front-load seal path.
Complaint: noisy / banging — drive motor, bearing, or suspension path.
Complaint: noisy / grinding — drain pump impeller or obstruction common.
Noisy with excessive tub movement — bearing or suspension likely.
Noisy with bad tub movement — suspect tub bearing or drive shaft.
Noisy with failed suspension — banging on spin or agitate.
Noisy with worn belt or pulley — squeal or slap common.
Noisy with failed drain — pump grinding or obstruction.
Noisy with abnormal drain pump amps — pump motor path supported.
F8E1 / Lo FL long fill — inlet path primary.
F9E1 long drain — pump and drain path primary.
F5E1 door switch open while locked — TEST #4.
F5E4/dr — door not opened between cycles (user or lock).
F0E5/ob off-balance — rebalance load before motor work.
F0E2/Sd oversuds — HE detergent and pressure hose.
F7E9 locked rotor — obstruction or motor fault (TEST #3).
Insignia E1 fill timeout — faucets, screens, inlet valve.
Insignia E2 drain timeout — hose, pump, lid closed.
Insignia F8 level sensor — frequency or capacitance out of spec.
FlexWash AC7 — upper↔lower PCB communication; check interconnect harness.
FlexWash DC4 — upper compartment door not closed.
4C2 — hot/cold hoses swapped or Wool/Lingerie water too hot.
Samsung SF system fault — main PCB microcontroller failure.
Upper FlexWash complaint — door lock and AC7 harness first.
Duet Sport F20 — no water in 6 min; inlet 750–850 Ω, pressure switch PR6.
Duet Sport F21 long drain — pump ~12.3 Ω; Sd may precede on oversuds.
Duet Sport F28 — CCU–MCU serial comm; check harness orientation at MCU.
F26 — door not opened 3 cycles or switch open while locked.
F27 overflow — inlet stuck on, drain pump, pressure switch.
Duet Sport motor out of ~6 Ω spec — F25 tach or no spin.
Duet Sport drain pump open — ~12.3 Ω expected at DP2.
Duet Sport inlet coil open — 750–850 Ω per leg.
